title: Cover review-input boot ordering and the reserved re-check with end-to-end tests
outcome: The review-input boot order (settle, then reconcile) is tested on a fresh AppState started from the store, the under-lock re-check that refuses check begin and submission recapture for a reserved or non-Running delegation is tested, and the vacuous explorer test is retargeted or removed.
acceptance: A test boots a fresh AppState from a store holding a Running read-only reviewer attempt (with and without a durable accepted envelope) and asserts settle-then-reconcile outcomes.
A test reserves the delegation (or ends its turn) between the check's authority read and check begin, and between a submission's snapshot and its recapture, and asserts the refusals.
review_input_identity_explorer_does_not_require_review_proof either submits a structured result that reaches the not-required branch or is removed.
